    AI Overview
    The Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival is held annually at the Empire Polo Club located at 81-800 Avenue 51, Indio, California 92201. Situated in the Coachella Valley within Riverside County, the venue is in the Southern California desert region, east of Palm Springs. The festival brings in thousands of people to the area to see performers, attend art exhibitions, and enjoy the scenery. 
    Key Location Details: 
    • Venue: Empire Polo Club.
    • Address: 81-800 Avenue 51, Indio, California 92201.
    • Region:
      Coachella Valley, Southern California.
    • Nearby City: Palm Springs (east of). 
    The venue is known for its sprawling green polo fields surrounded by desert, accommodating both the stages and large camping areas for attendees.
